explanation: The theorem is about `twoOpenIntersectionToRight`, which the library defines itself as `TopCat.openMap (𝟙 X) (U ⊓ V) V _`. Its proof relies on `TopCat.openMap_comp_inclusion`, which is also the library's own declaration. I grepped Mathlib for `openMap_comp_inclusion`, `TopCat.openMap` and `def openMap` and found nothing. I also read `Mathlib/Topology/Category/TopCat/Opens.lean`, which has `toTopCat`, `toTopCat_map` and `inclusion'`. It has no lemma saying that `(toTopCat X).map (homOfLE h) ≫ V.inclusion' = U.inclusion'`. A grep for `toTopCat.*inclusion'` and `_comp_inclusion'` across Mathlib found only the definition of `inclusion'`. So I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result.
